title: Inject loss, reordering, and duplication
description: Apply the same network incident to different data meanings. The lab separates what TCP or UDP exposes from what the application must still guarantee.

impairments.label: Packet is lost
impairments.detail: One packet never reaches the receiver and later traffic continues.

impairments.label: Packets arrive out of order
impairments.detail: A newer packet reaches the receiver before an older packet.

impairments.label: Packet is duplicated
impairments.detail: The same logical payload reaches the receiver twice.
